notes: This portable C++ TCK case unpublishes every adapter-configured ordinary application attribute with the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API and requests the resulting publication state through the standard IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. With no object classes containing published application attributes, the expected object-class report is the MIM-defined NULL response with zero classes and no object-class or attribute-list parameters. The provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, names, and MIM module remain adapter-supplied; the test uses no vendor implementation hooks or DDM region APIs.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unpublishObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes) = 0
